item.text:
`test/orders.js` exports simple shop order helpers: it totals line items, applies `SAVE10`/`SAVE20` discounts, computes average item price, and formats an order summary string.

Bugs found:

- `calcTotal(items)`: loop uses `i <= items.length`, so it reads `items[items.length]` and crashes with `Cannot read properties of undefined`. It should be `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: divides by `items.length`, so empty arrays return `NaN` once `calcTotal` is fixed. It needs an explicit empty-array behavior.
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: despite the name, it returns average line total per item entry, not average unit price. For quantities over 1, this may be logically wrong.
